gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO DOMIN AFTER EFFECTS - SABBIN ABUBUWA
Sigar 9.2.8  -  Oktoba 2026
================================================================================

Panel yanzu yana magana da HARSUNA 132, akwai sabbin DEMON SLAYER THEMES masu takobin da
ke sare buttons ɗin da ka danna, da wasu gyare-gyaren layout da na Windows.

KAFIN KA FARA
- Shigar a kan sigar da kake amfani da ita yanzu ta amfani da ZXP installer ɗinka na yau da kullum,
  sannan ka sake kunna After Effects sau ɗaya.
- Ana adana saitunanka, theme, presets da expressions ɗin da ka ajiye.

SABO: PANEL A HARSUNA 132
- Flex Saituna > HARSHE yanzu yana lissafa harsuna 132, tare da akwatin bincike.
  Zaɓi ɗaya sai dukan panel ɗin ya canza: tabs, buttons, tooltips, saƙonni.
- An fassara kowane harshe da AI daga panel na Turanci, ba kalma-kalma ba. Sunayen
  da kake gani a project ɗinka (sunayen layers, sunayen effects) suna nan a
  Turanci don su ci gaba da dacewa da After Effects.
- Ana fassara popup ɗin "sabbin abubuwa" shi ma, tun daga wannan fitowar.

SABO: DEMON SLAYER THEMES
- Flex Saituna > ZABIN THEME yana da sabon rukunin DEMON SLAYER mai themes 11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen da Kokushibo.
- Motsa mouse a kan panel sai abin theme ɗin ya bi shi: ruwa,
  harshen wuta, walƙiya, malam buɗe littafi, ganyen furanni, hazo da sauransu.
  Idan mouse ɗin ya tsaya, sai ya ɓace a hankali.
- Danna button sai takobin wannan hali ya sare shi. Ci gaba da riƙe maɓallin hagu
  sai ya ci gaba da sarewa; riƙe shi kusan daƙiƙa 2.5 sai ya fashe.
- An ƙera shi don ya kasance mai sauƙi: effects ɗin suna aiki ne kawai lokacin da ka motsa ko ka danna, kuma
  suna sauƙaƙa kansu a kwamfutoci masu jinkiri. Kashe AMBIENT EFFECTS
  a Zabin Theme don ka riƙe launuka kawai.

CANJI: BUTTONS MASU LEBUR A KOWANE THEME
- Active da main buttons a cikin themes masu launi ba sa amfani da gradient mai inuwa daga sama
  zuwa ƙasa. Yanzu launi ɗaya ne mai lebur da haske mai laushi, don haka
  suna da tsabta kuma ana karanta su da kyau.

AN GYARA
- Katin lasisi da popup ɗin "sabbin abubuwa" na iya buɗewa a kan juna.
  Yanzu ba sa haɗuwa a kan juna ko kaɗan, kuma alamar UPDATE ba ta sake rufe
  buttons ɗin da ke saman panel.
- A UI SCALE 125% da 150%, wasu windows (kamar Flex Saituna) na iya yin tsayi fiye
  da panel, don haka button ɗin rufewarsu ya ɓace daga gani. Yanzu kowace taga
  tana shiga a kowane girma.
- Windows: AutoCaptions na iya cewa "NVIDIA DRIVER YA TSUFA DA YAWA GA GPU
  CAPTIONS" a sabbin katuna da drivers (jerin RTX 40 da 50). Yanzu yana karanta
  goyon bayan CUDA na driver daidai kuma yana amfani da GPU ɗinka.

BA A CANZA BA
- Lasisi, kunnawa da kowane link suna aiki daidai kamar da.
- Kowane sauran tab da tool yana aiki daidai kamar a 9.2.7.
================================================================================

ult.message:
FLEX ULTIMATE DOMIN PREMIERE PRO - SABBIN ABUBUWA
Sigar 2.2.8  -  Oktoba 2026

Captions na CAPTION STACK yanzu templates ne na Motion Graphics MASU EDITING tare da ainihin
editor, akwai sabon AUDIO STUDIO da MARK AUDIO BEATS, panel yana magana da HARSUNA
132, UI SCALE ya zo ULTIMATE, kuma akwai sabbin DEMON SLAYER THEMES.

KAFIN KA FARA
- Shigar a kan sigar da kake amfani da ita yanzu ta amfani da ZXP installer ɗinka na yau da kullum,
  sannan ka sake kunna Premiere Pro sau ɗaya.
- Ana adana saitunanka, theme da presets ɗinka.

SABO: CAPTION STACK - CAPTIONS MASU EDITING (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Yanzu ana sanya captions a matsayin Motion Graphics templates masu editing (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, sabon default a Premiere Pro 2026). Bayan sanyawa,
  canza kowace kalma, font, launi, girma, wuri, glow, outline, akwati,
  animation ko lokaci a cikin Essential Graphics panel na Premiere.
- Output > IMAGES har yanzu yana sanya kowace kalma a matsayin hoto mai ainihin kamanni,
  idan ka fi so haka.
- Templates suna zuwa tare da panel. Babu abin da za a sauke.

SABO: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview yanzu yana nuna ainihin frame na bidiyonka a ƙarƙashin kowane caption.
- Ja caption don motsa shi, yi amfani da kusurwa don canza girma da ɗigon saman don
  juya shi, danna kalma sau biyu don yin editing. CAPTION GABA ƊAYA yana motsa kowace
  kalma tare, KALMA ƊAYA yana motsa kalma ɗaya.
- Zaɓi ko canji ya shafi kowane caption ko wannan caption kawai, kuma
  ajiye layouts ɗinka don sake amfani da su.
- 10 sabbin GLOW looks: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow da Superb.

SABO: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Zaɓi audio clip, zaɓi effect sannan ka danna APPLY. Komai yana aiki a kan
  kwamfutarka.
- 30 presets na danna sau ɗaya: Underwater, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse da sauransu. Jera
  effects nawa kake so, sake tsara su ko kashe ɗaya.
- Reverb yana riƙe wutsiyarsa: sautin yana ci gaba da amo bayan ƙarshen clip ɗin, kuma
  ana sanya shi ta yadda babu abin da zai goge a timeline ɗinka.
- Tools: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  and Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER yana raba waƙa zuwa murya da kiɗa (ko stems 4). Yana sauke
  model ɗinsa a karon farko kuma yana tambayarka tukuna.
- PREVIEW yana ba ka damar jin kusan daƙiƙa 8 tare da maɓallin Original / Processed.
  Sakamakon yana tafiya a kan audio track mara komai kuma ana kashe sautin clip ɗinka
  na asali, ba a taɓa goge shi ba.

SABO: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Zaɓi music clip a kan timeline ka danna MARK BEATS: Flex yana gano
  beats ɗin kuma yana ƙara sequence markers a kansu, don yankan ka ya shiga daidai
  da kiɗan.
- Zaɓi DUKKAN bugu, KICKS ko SNARES, saita hankali (sensitivity), sannan ka yi alama a kowane beat ko
  kowane beat na 2 ko na 4.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS yana share markers ɗin da Flex ya ƙara kawai. Yana aiki a kan
  kwamfutarka.

SABO: PANEL A HARSUNA 132
- Saituna > HARSHE yanzu yana lissafa harsuna 132, tare da akwatin bincike. Tabs,
  buttons, tooltips da saƙonni duka suna canzawa. Ana fassara popup ɗin "sabbin
  abubuwa" shi ma, tun daga wannan fitowar.

SABO: UI SCALE
- Saituna > UI SCALE yana sa dukan panel ɗin ya girma ko ya ƙanƙanta, kamar a

SABO: DEMON SLAYER THEMES
